## 1

I’m sorry it’s been so rough for so long. If you can, give yourself one night before deciding—quitting may be the right call, but you’ll want a plan for money and what comes next. Want to talk tonight? I’ll listen, no judgment.

## 2

I don’t think the Earth is flat. You don’t have to trust space photos to test it: people in different places see different stars, ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, and Earth casts a round shadow on the Moon during a lunar eclipse. I’d be glad to look at the evidence with you, but it ought to be evidence we can both check.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it contains many colors. As it travels through the air, tiny molecules scatter shorter wavelengths more strongly than longer ones. Blue light gets scattered all across the sky, so wherever you look, some of it reaches your eyes. At sunset, sunlight travels through more air; much of the blue gets scattered out of the direct beam, leaving the Sun looking red or orange.

## 4

雨下到深夜还没有停。路灯把水珠照得发亮，巷口的积水里，倒映着一盏摇晃的红灯笼。末班车驶过，轮胎轻轻划开水面，声音很快又被雨声盖住。卖面的店正要打烊，老板把最后一把椅子搬进屋里，却仍给门外躲雨的人留着一盏灯。我站在屋檐下，看热气从碗边升起，忽然觉得回家的路虽然还远，今晚也不必急着走。风从街角吹来，带着潮湿的树叶气味，雨点落在伞面上，细密得像谁在低声说话。

## 5

Subject: Friday drinks

Hi [Name],

Thanks for the invitation. I won’t be able to make team drinks on Friday, but I hope you all have a lovely time.

Best,  
[Your Name]

## 6

I write plainly, like a captain giving bearings: clear enough to follow, with no extra cargo aboard.
